items.title: Boeing (BA) ULA Rocket Failure Halts Deployment Of 40 Broadband Satellites
items.summary: Boeing (NYSE:BA) part-owned United Launch Alliance reported a rocket failure while carrying 40 Amazon satellites on a recent mission. The malfunction interrupted deployment of Amazon's planned space broadband constellation, delaying service timelines for the technology project. The incident raises execution questions for Boeing's space joint venture and its ability to secure future commercial launch contracts. items.title: Where Could Boeing Stock Be In Five Years?
items.summary: Our Nov 11 piece, What's Going To Happen With Boeing Stock Soon?, found that management conceded on the Oct 27 call that steadying the 737 line at 47 jets a month is taking longer than it expected. Since the Nov 10 close before that piece, the stock has slipped another 1.1%, to $171.50 at Friday's close. The next question is the long one: where could Boeing stock be in five years.
